values.en: The closed signature and the open-expression extension are separate: fvar belongs only to the latter. Globally resolved names are context-independent constants, not free-variable nodes. This project convention is not a substitute for standard closedness: being well-scoped only excludes dangling de Bruijn indices and does not exclude free variables in the open extension.
values.zh-CN: 闭表达式签名与开表达式扩展是分开的：fvar 仅属于后者。全局已解析名称是与语境无关的常量，不是自由变量节点。本项目约定不能代替标准闭性：良作用域仅排除悬空的 de Bruijn 指数，并不排除开表达式扩展中的自由变量。
